get_bedrock_status.description: Get the live status of a Bedrock Edition server: whether it is online, its version and protocol, the current and maximum player counts, the MOTD (raw, clean, and HTML), the gamemode, the server id, and the edition (MCPE or MCEE).

motd.clean:
A Bedrock server
You cannot connect!
motd.raw:
A Bedrock server
You cannot connect!

get_bedrock_status.name: get_bedrock_status

parameters.description: The server's connection address: a hostname or IP, optionally with a port as host:port. Leave the port off to use the edition's default (25565 for Java, 19132 for Bedrock).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

get_bedrock_widget.description: Render a Bedrock Edition server's status as a banner image (PNG) showing its MOTD, version, and player count. Returns a live embeddable URL, Markdown and HTML snippets, and a base64 data URI. Customise the look with the dark, rounded, and transparent options.
get_bedrock_widget.display_str_template: Get the Bedrock server widget for {0}.
get_bedrock_widget.name: get_bedrock_widget

parameters.description: The server's connection address: a hostname or IP, optionally with a port as host:port. Leave the port off to use the edition's default (25565 for Java, 19132 for Bedrock).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Use the dark colour scheme. Enabled by default.
parameters.name: dark

parameters.description: Round the widget's corners. Enabled by default.
parameters.name: rounded

parameters.description: Make the widget background transparent. Disabled by default.
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

get_java_status.description: Get the live status of a Java Edition server: whether it is online, its version and protocol, the current and maximum player counts (and a sample player list when the server shares one), the MOTD (raw, clean, and HTML), the server icon, and any advertised mods, plugins, and software.
get_java_status.name: get_java_status

parameters.description: The server's connection address: a hostname or IP, optionally with a port as host:port. Leave the port off to use the edition's default (25565 for Java, 19132 for Bedrock).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Also use the server's query protocol to fetch extra details such as the plugin list. Enabled by default; it has no effect on servers that keep query disabled.
parameters.name: enable_query

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

get_java_widget.description: Render a Java Edition server's status as a banner image (PNG) showing its icon, MOTD, version, and player count. Returns a live embeddable URL, Markdown and HTML snippets, and a base64 data URI. Customise the look with the dark, rounded, and transparent options.
get_java_widget.display_str_template: Get the Java server widget for {0}.
get_java_widget.name: get_java_widget

parameters.description: The server's connection address: a hostname or IP, optionally with a port as host:port. Leave the port off to use the edition's default (25565 for Java, 19132 for Bedrock).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Use the dark colour scheme. Enabled by default.
parameters.name: dark

parameters.description: Round the widget's corners. Enabled by default.
parameters.name: rounded

parameters.description: Make the widget background transparent. Disabled by default.
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

get_server_icon.description: Get a Java Edition server's 64x64 icon as a PNG. Returns a live embeddable URL, ready-to-use Markdown and HTML snippets, and a base64 data URI of the image. Falls back to the default icon when the server is offline or has no custom icon.
get_server_icon.name: get_server_icon

parameters.description: The server's connection address: a hostname or IP, optionally with a port as host:port. Leave the port off to use the edition's default (25565 for Java, 19132 for Bedrock).
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

send_vote.description: Send a Votifier vote to a Minecraft server. Requires the server host and the voting username, plus one credential: a Votifier 2 token (preferred) or a Votifier 1 RSA public key. The server must be running a Votifier-compatible listener.
send_vote.display_str_template: Send a Votifier vote for {1} to {0}.

mock_response.message: The vote was successfully sent to the server.

send_vote.name: send_vote

parameters.description: The Minecraft server's hostname or IP running the Votifier listener, e.g. play.example.com.
parameters.name: host

parameters.description: The Minecraft username being credited with the vote.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: The Votifier 2 token from the server's plugin config. Provide this (preferred) or a Votifier 1 public key.
parameters.name: token

parameters.description: The Votifier 1 RSA public key (the contents of the server's rsa/public.key). Provide this or a Votifier 2 token.
parameters.name: public_key

parameters.description: The Votifier listener port. Defaults to 8192.
parameters.name: port

parameters.description: The voting player's Minecraft UUID. Optional.
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.description: The service name recorded with the vote. Defaults to mcstatus.io.
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.description: When the vote occurred. Optional; defaults to the time the action runs.
parameters.name: timestamp

parameters.description: The voting player's IP address. Optional; defaults to the request's IP.
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to respond before giving up. Optional; defaults to 5 seconds.
parameters.name: timeout

description: Check any Minecraft server's live status through the keyless mcstatus.io public API. Get Java or Bedrock Edition status (online state, version, player count, MOTD, mods, and plugins), fetch a server's icon, render a status-widget banner image, and send Votifier votes. No account or API key required.
